piñcha.p: [ pata + cha. Patituṃ icchati yena piñchaṃ. Nerutto. Pata gamane vā, cho. Dhāna, ṭī. Pichi + a. Pācita, yo. ] (na) Google Translate (1) U Dun, Crest. (2) riding a horse; tail Tail hair. (3) Bird Mountain.

O:
piñcha：ပိဉ္ဆ
ဘူ = ဗာဓေ-နှိပ်စက်ခြင်း၌။ ပိစ္ဆတိ။ ကောတ္ထုဘ။
R:
piñcha：ပိဉ္ဆ （န）
အမြီးတောင်။ပိစ္ဆ
DOP: piñja piñcha piccha n. [ S. piccha, S. lex. piñcha], a tail-feather (especially of a peacock); (perhaps also: a wing); Abh 635 (kalāpo ~am, Ce so; Be piñcham); 1085; Ja I 207, 27´ (pekkhuṇānī ti ~āni, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be piñchāni); III 226, 24* (~āni tattha lāyitvā, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce piñchāni; 227, 1´ : ~ānī ti ~āni, Ee so; Be piñchānī ti pattāni; Ce piñchānī ti picchāni; Se piñjānī ti pucchāni); Ap 585, 19 (dakkhiṇaṃ ca saraṃ ~aṃ, Ce so; Ee picchaṃ; Be, Se piñchaṃ); Dhp-a I 394, 12 (akkhīni maṇimayāni tathā gīvā ca ~āni ca, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se piñchāni); Sadd 782, 6 (kañcanavaṇṇā dve picchā dve pakkhā yassa haṃsarājassa so ’yaṃ kañcanadvepiccho); — ifc see mora-; — °- vaṭṭi , f. , the mass of tail-feathers; Sv 487, 22 (supaṇṇarājā ca diyaḍḍhayojanasatiko, tassa … ~i saṭṭhiyojanikā, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be piñcha-; Sv-pṭ II 108, 25 : ~ī ti °-kalāpo) = Spk II 88, 30 ( Ee so; Be, Ce, Se piñcha-); — see also kañcanadepiccha ( sv kañcana ).
